name: Trap Hole
description: Hide a trap on 1d6 red cells, callable on your turn.

name: Shield +1
description: Distribute 1d6 points of extra shield, up to 6.

name: Sword +1
description: Distribute 1d6 points of extra attack, no limit.

name: Field Card +X
description: All monsters with the chosen attribute or type gain +1 ATK, +2 ATK and +1 DEF.

name: Wings
description: Distribute the flying attribute to 1d6/2 (round up) monsters, letting them fly over creatures and empty cells.

name: Energy
description: Gain the d6 roll in energy.
